category: Key Imaginary Lines on a Globe
explanation: The Equator, Tropic of Cancer, Prime Meridian, and International Date Line are all imaginary lines of latitude or longitude used to define coordinates and time zones on Earth. Aurora Borealis is a natural atmospheric phenomenon.

The Great Pyramid, Statue of Zeus, Temple of Artemis, and Mausoleum are widely accepted as historically existing structures among the Seven Ancient Wonders of the World (though most are now destroyed). The existence and exact location of the Hanging Gardens of Babylon are extensively debated by historians and archaeologists, making it the odd one out.
Lamp, Torch, Candle, and Lantern are all objects designed to produce or emit light. A Mirror reflects light rather than producing it.
